import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
# Handle NaN in Sleep Disorder
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=80)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Physical Activity Level vs Stress Level by BMI Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_categories = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
for bmi in bmi_categories:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax2.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'], 
               label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=80)
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.9, len(occupation_sleep)))
ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax3.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sleep_disorders = df['Sleep Disorder'].unique()
heart_rate_data = [df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]['Heart Rate'].dropna() 
                   for disorder in sleep_disorders]
bp = ax4.boxplot(heart_rate_data, labels=sleep_disorders, patch_artist=True,
                 medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2),
                 boxprops=dict(facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7))
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
